scope: Actual multipart receiving surfaces for manual helicopter guns and vehicle ordnance
confirmedCodeDefects: Manual helicopter cannon ignored PartEntity hits while the AI cannon had an explicit animated receiver.
Manual Hellfire stored transient part UUIDs, but flight resolves targets through ServerLevel.getEntity(UUID).
Vehicle projectile collision wrapper replaced the native animated surface point with the coarse proxy AABB intersection.
Vehicle ordnance direct hits only recognized LivingEntity; blast candidates and distances only used parent root AABBs.
changes: Shared HydraHurtContact.ray selects the nearest real cuboid contact for guns.
Player cannon applies parent permissions and the real barrel ray to hurtAt; persistent parent used for guided target identity.
Collision wrapper retains already-narrowed animated part points, preserving first-wall ordering.
Direct shells/rapid rockets resolve the parent and preserve the impact bone.
Explosion candidates include loaded multipart bodies and use one nearest actual skin surface per entity; independent Greene appendage armor receives the damage.
Existing cover, PvP, allied protection, source blast timing/ratios and per-entity wave contact history remain in their owning paths.
Manual cannon excludes ground-vehicle coarse pick boxes; only the oriented mechanical hull query may receive that hit.
Explosion surface selection now checks exposure before choosing the nearest limb; a hidden near limb cannot suppress an exposed farther limb within radius.

Two VehicleOrdnanceBodyGameTest cases: native AP collision to appendage; first Hellfire sphere on limb outside parent root box.
OrdnanceBodyContactTest: blocked near limb, exposed farther limb, radius limit and complete cover.
